detailed_descriptions.en: Roguefort is a turn-based open-world roguelike RPG where magic is cultivated through cheesemaking. You play as an affineur , exploring a continent contested by five great Guilds on the verge of war. Crawl dungeons, build a homestead, tame and ride animals, or sail with friends. There's also Fortress mode, where you build and manage a colony of your own. Raise livestock, forage for ingredients and experiment with recipes. Blind your enemies with a smoked gouda fog, then heal yourself with a sunberry tomme. Or just wail on them with a two-handed sword. Choose Guild disciplines, perks and keystones as you develop your character. The land and the ingredients you gather shape your magic, so where you settle matters too. Start a settlement on a generated continent in Fortress mode. Give your settlers work, build workshops, dig underground and keep everyone fed through the seasons. Grow crops, raise livestock, make cheese and trade what you produce. Your settlers have their own skills, needs and relationships. Send expeditions out into the world and prepare your colony's defences. Time keeps moving while people work, and you can pause whenever you need to plan. Cantal's landscape is handcrafted, while its dungeons, encounters, weather and ecology change between runs. The Crossing gives you a newly generated continent each time, with its own history. Meet people who work, grow old and remember your deeds (and misdeeds). Take on Guild quests, build a reputation and decide who you'll stand with as war approaches. Your choices lead to branching quests and different endings. Sail past coastal cities, go below deck and make the ship your own. Build a workbench, store your supplies and fish from the railing. You can take your home with you. Play your adventure in classic ASCII, pixel art, 2.5D isometric or first-person 3D, all powered by the custom-made Opthalis Engine . Switch between them whenever you like. Choose Permadeath for a traditional roguelike challenge, or pick Wayfarer mode, where death has consequences, but you can continue onwards with your character. Play co-op with up to four players in one world. Explore, build, raid dungeons, sail and quest together. In single player, visit the Old Mouth trading hub to meet other players, trade, chat and send in-game mail.
